title: Let’s go @Berkeley Repertory Theatre, consistently feeding us new mus...
transcript: What a huge week for Berkeley Rep and Musical Theatre News. Yesterday it was announced that Galileo is in fact taking the Shubert, though not until next season in November. This is an original musical with a rock score about Galileo Galilei, played by Raul Esparza, and his daughter, played on Broadway by Joy Woods. Cannot wait. I previously saw the first preview of its world premiere at Berkeley Rep, so obviously it needed a lot of work, but I thought it showed a lot of promise even then. I'm really excited to see where this ended up. And Galileo is one of the many musicals to have their premiere at Berkeley Rep, including the just announced today production of the. Interesting. This is the musical based off of the book, with a new original score by Sarah Bareilles. I cannot wait. Also got a book by Sarah Ruhl, who has written a ton of incredible plays, and the book to wonder, which I really enjoyed recently. And the newest addition to this creative team is Michael Arden, officially signing on as the director. This is the first show to be announced as part of Berkeley Rep's 26 27 season. It'll be starting performances in January of 2027. And you better believe. You better believe I'm going to the Bay Area for this. I would not miss this for the world.
